name: Elling Trias
summary: In Stormwind's Trade District, Elling Trias runs a cheese shop with his family. He welcomes customers with easy talk, while his quiet work as an information broker reaches across continents.

sections.title: The Master Cheesemonger
sections.body: Elling Trias sells fine cheese in the Trade District, working beside his wife Elaine and son Ben. He cheerfully offers wheels of cheese and chats with the townsfolk. To those who know better, Trias' Cheese is one of Stormwind's most reliable fronts. The city's steady trade gives operatives, courtiers and adventurers a place to exchange quiet words beyond the city watch's notice.

sections.title: A Web of Whispers
sections.body: Elling Trias has informants and allies far beyond what most shopkeepers can claim. He keeps ties with Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7, works with Church contacts such as Bishop DeLavey, and corresponds with agents in Darkshire, Theramore Isle and the distant Plaguelands near Hearthglen. When rumors surface about highway bandits or quiet movements in the countryside, Trias often pieces them together before the royal court takes notice.

sections.title: The Missing Diplomat
sections.body: Elling Trias helps investigators untangle the disappearance of a high-ranking diplomat during a voyage to Theramore. He points them toward his contacts, including an estranged operative named Jorgen and an old friend, Tyrion. Their trail exposes the Defias Brotherhood's part in the abduction. Beneath his sharp wit and cynical banter, Elling sees that the plot reaches deep into Stormwind's aristocracy.

faq.answer: Elling Trias runs a cheese shop in Stormwind's Trade District with his family. He also works as an experienced information broker, with ties to SI:7, the Church and distant outposts across Azeroth.

faq.q: Where is his cheese shop located?
faq.answer: Trias' Cheese is in Stormwind City's Trade District, along the outer canal wall near the border with Old Town.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Elling Trias is not a member of the Defias Brotherhood. He tracks their movements through his informant network and helps Alliance adventurers trace their part in plots, including the kidnapping of a royal diplomat.

faq.q: How does he know Mathias Shaw?
faq.answer: Mathias Shaw has known Elling Trias for years and turns to him when official channels fail. Shaw hates asking, and Elling grumbles when his work helps Shaw and SI:7. The shop offers a place to make discreet inquiries outside royal channels.

faq.q: Who runs the shop with him?
faq.answer: Elling runs Trias' Cheese with his wife, Elaine Trias, and son, Ben Trias. Together, they keep the shop looking like an ordinary family trade.

faq.q: What is his involvement in the Missing Diplomat investigation?
faq.answer: Bishop DeLavey sends investigators to Elling Trias, whose contacts include old associates Jorgen and Tyrion. Their leads trace Defias movements and reveal who seized the diplomat bound for Theramore.

angles.text: As a rogue, you know a cheese shop can make an ideal drop point. Elling's place near Old Town and his close ties to Mathias Shaw make it a fixture in Stormwind's underworld.
As an Alliance member, you can count on Elling to quietly gather rumors from Theramore to Hearthglen and help guard the realm against threats within.
